newsitem.title: CHINA: China to have 6.8 mln mobile phone users by end-96.
newsitem.headline: China to have 6.8 mln mobile phone users by end-96.

text.p: China expects to have 6.8 million mobile phone subscribers by the end of the year, the Workers' Daily said on Tuesday.
There were 6.52 million mobile phone users as of early December, the newspaper said, quoting an official of the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications.
The official forecast that the number of mobile phone subscribers would exceed 10 million in 1997 and hit 20 million by the year 2000.
The newspaper gave no further details.
